name: Shadow Guards

stealth.note: (trained) to notice the runes concealed among the drawings

description: Shadowy caricatures of elves peel themselves from the floor and attack everyone in the room.
disable: DC 16 Acrobatics check to move through the room without touching any of the runes, followed by DC 18 Thievery check (trained) to carve them out of the wood without triggering them; or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 16) to counteract the runes
reset: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute. The drawings cannot pursue characters out of the room.
routine: (1 action) The drawings stab at each character in the room with spears drawn from sharp lines.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shadow Rush
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the room

Effect After waiting 1 round, the trap animates its shadowy stick figures and makes a painted spear Strike against each creature in the room. The trap rolls initiative.
